metaDescription: Portfolio of Derek Warner-Reyes, Software Engineer.
bioContent:
Fullstack software engineer experienced in building, testing, and maintaining web and mobile applications from conception to production. Most recently served as lead fullstack software engineer at Olio Apps from 2021-2026.

In my free time I enjoy reading, writing, playing saxophone, cycling, and going to concerts. I'm also a passionate home chef, loving uncle, and I enjoy supporting my community through local activism and volunteer work.
name: Derek Warner-Reyes
